text: 从昆明海关获悉，今年前7个月，经中老铁路进出口货值201.1亿元、同比增长29.9%。据昆明海关统计，今年前7个月，经中老铁路进口东盟热带水果49.2亿元、同比增长14.9%，出口新能源汽车、光伏产品等“新三样”23.1亿元、同比增长306.2%，跨境电商B2B出口货值同比增长1.5倍。其中，进口榴莲15.8万吨，同比增长25.6%。依托中老铁路这条“黄金大通道”，“中国智造南下，东南亚特产北上”双向贸易格局加速形成。（新华社）
text_en: According to Kunming Customs, in the first seven months of this year, the import and export value via the China-Laos Railway reached RMB 20.11 billion, up 29.9% year-on-year. Kunming Customs statistics show that in the first seven months, imports of ASEAN tropical fruits via the China-Laos Railway reached RMB 4.92 billion, up 14.9% year-on-year, while exports of 'new three' items such as new energy vehicles and photovoltaic products reached RMB 2.31 billion, up 306.2% year-on-year, and cross-border e-commerce B2B export value rose 1.5 times year-on-year. Among these, durian imports reached 158,000 tons, up 25.6% year-on-year. Relying on this 'golden corridor' of the China-Laos Railway, a two-way trade pattern of 'Chinese smart manufacturing heading south and Southeast Asian specialties heading north' is accelerating. (Xinhua)
